name: Inukko Punipuni ~Hatsujou Keihou Hatsurei Chuu~
original_name: 犬っ娘ぷにぷに～発情警報発令中～
source:
One day a volcano erupts on the island where demi-humans live. Female cousin is allowed to stay at the relatives place in the mainland till danger passes. Demi-humans constitution changes depending on climate. Female cousin in particular starts to get horny periodically. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，亚人居住的岛屿上发生火山喷发。危险解除前，女表亲获准暂住在大陆亲戚家中。亚人的体质会随气候发生变化，尤其是这位女表亲，她开始周期性地进入发情状态。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
